publicBenchmark.disclosure: The 98% objective has not been met. The six-corpus 366-track table is an iterative held-out audit, not a pristine one-shot estimate. The separate 500-track NRG-CP confirmation is disjoint and was scored once after v8 froze. NRG-CP is symbolic/rendered; BabySlakh uses score-derived rather than human chord annotations. Travis songs were not used. Production remains v2 pending product review.
publicBenchmark.metricSemantics: Enharmonic roots are compared by pitch class. Major/minor collapses triad and seventh families; detailed recall distinguishes them. Boundary F1 uses a 250 ms tolerance.
publicBenchmark.selectionRule: Quality confidence gates, factorized decoding, a 50/50 boundary blend, and a 0.90 sparse-texture fallback gate were frozen on development data before the disjoint 500-composition confirmation run.
